title: bigbang-core values
description: Values for the bigbang-core parent chart, which renders one Flux HelmRelease per entry in `packages` plus the labeled namespaces.

profile.description: Named profile overlay from core/profiles/<name>.yaml (e.g. minimal, ambient); merged over these values (profile wins on the keys it sets).

groups.description: Package groups; disabling a group gates out every package tagged with it.

domain.description: Base domain for exposed services; merged into every package's values.

enabled.description: Ambient mesh mode (default true): deploy istio-cni + ztunnel, run istiod with ambient/HBONE, set istio.ambient.enabled on every Package CR, and label mesh namespaces istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient. Set false for sidecar mode.

imagePullSecret.description: Airgap/Zarf: copy the registry pull secret from the release namespace into every package namespace.

copyFromReleaseNamespace.description: When true, copy the pull secret (imagePullSecret.name) from the release namespace into each enabled package namespace so rewritten image refs can authenticate to the in-cluster registry.

name.description: Name of the pull secret to copy (and to create in each package namespace).

source.description: Flux source the child HelmReleases pull their charts from.

flux.description: Merged into every child HelmRelease spec (Flux HelmRelease spec fields, e.g. interval/timeout/install/upgrade/rollback). Per-package `flux` overrides.

packageValues.description: Merged into every package HelmRelease's Helm values; per-package `values` override these.

packages.description: One Flux HelmRelease per entry, keyed by package name.

enabled.description: Render this package's HelmRelease and namespace.

releaseName.description: Helm release name (defaults to the package key).

chart.description: Chart path within the repo (the Flux source).

oci.description: Published OCI Helm chart, used instead of a local chart path.

wave.description: Ordering wave; a package dependsOn every enabled package in a lower wave.

requiresAmbient.description: Only deploy when istio.ambient.enabled is true (e.g. istio-cni, ztunnel).

group.description: Group name; the package is gated out when groups.<name>.enabled is false.

meshInjection.description: Label this package's namespace for mesh enrollment: istio-injection=enabled in sidecar mode, istio.io/dataplane-mode=ambient in ambient mode.

namespaceLabels.description: Literal labels applied to the package's namespace (mode-independent).

values.description: Helm values passed to this package's chart (overrides packageValues).

flux.description: Per-package Flux HelmRelease spec overrides (merged over the top-level flux).
